messages:
nina_cs: Tidewater day0 preflight - dropping the short list of barriers we hit during the dry run. owners + ETAs please.

omar_se: thanks nina. paste them and i'll open the CS ticket.

nina_cs: issues: 1) outbound firewall missing for our audit collector endpoints (see hosts/CIDRs below), 2) customer wants a cross-account KMS grant for their ingestion role, 3) uploader role arn not present in bucket policy so uploads are 403ing, 4) audit-forwarder lambda failed on dryrun with a 504, 5) renewal flag: Tidewater asked if we can do a 10% renewal credit if we commit to a 99.9% Dedicated SLO next year.

jules_infra: can you paste concrete hostnames + CIDRs? i'll file a network change.

nina_cs: hosts: audit-collector.tidewater.internal, splunk-forwarder.tidewater, logs-relay-1.tidewater. CIDRs they use: 10.200.0.0/22 and 203.0.113.0/24.

jules_infra: ok creating NETCHG-2147 for egress to those hosts, target deploy TOM EOD PST. assigning to netops.

poppy_eng: KMS - which principal did they specify? we usually add role ARN with kms:Decrypt + kms:GenerateDataKey.

nina_cs: they want arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/tidewater-ingest-role and asked to include kms:DescribeKey too.

poppy_eng: i'll draft a minimal key policy snippet for them to paste into their template and also prepare the version we'd attach to the customer key.

poppy_eng: ```json
{"Sid":"AllowTidewaterIngest","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/tidewater-ingest-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```

omar_se: about the S3 uploader - do we have the uploader role ARN? we need a putobject statement limited to prefix `incoming/tidewater/`.

nina_cs: they expect `arn:aws:iam::999000111222:role/redwood-uploader`.

omar_se: i'll check bucket policy and if absent will add a statement like: `Allow s3:PutObject` for that role on `arn:aws:s3:::rbw-logs/incoming/tidewater/*`. ETA 24h.

nina_cs: lambda error (audit-forwarder): logs show a gateway timeout on the function `rbw-audit-forwarder-prod`. snippet below.

nina_cs: ```
[2026-04-01T09:12:07Z] ERROR RequestId: a1b2c3d4 Runtime.GatewayTimeout: POST /s3/upload 504 after 60s
    at handler (/var/task/index.js:72:18)
```

poppy_eng: 60s timeout, interesting. short-term: increase to 120s and add exponential retry, long-term: switch to multipart uploads with concurrency. i'll raise PR for the timeout config today.

omar_se: owners recap: jules_infra -> netops egress change, omar_se -> bucket policy update, poppy_eng -> KMS snippet + lambda timeout PR, nina_cs -> confirm ARNs with customer + own renewal note. i'll create CS-7011 and tag sales.

deploybot: Ticket created: CS-7011 by omar_se - Tidewater day0 preflight (network/KMS/S3/audit). Priority: P2.

nina_cs: renewal follow-up: please don't promise discounts. I've set renewal_risk=medium on the account card and linked the ask. SalesOps - can you advise on precedent for a 10% credit for SLO upgrade?

omar_se: netops confirmed 203.0.113.0/24 whitelisted (change NET-2147 deployed).

poppy_eng: draft runbook for 30m cutover (will paste in 20m) - short steps + verification checks.

nina_cs: thanks all. i'll update the customer board and ping Tidewater for the role ARN confirmation and KMS rotation schedule. will post blockers here.

omars_infra: :thumbsup:
